# The Diggers Play

> Portable remote-control (RC) construction play for children's parties, fairs, schools and corporate events. Real RC excavators, loaders, cranes and trucks in a protected sand arena, indoors or outdoors. Based in Worksop, Nottinghamshire, travelling across the Midlands and the North of England.

## Key pages
- [Kids birthday parties](https://thediggersplay.com/kids-birthday-parties/): Little Diggers Farm (ages 3 to 6, from GBP 360) and Pro Operators Site (ages 6+, from GBP 480)
- [Corporate events](https://thediggersplay.com/corporate-events/): Treasure Hunt and Construction Site formats, quoted individually
- [Fairs, schools and community events](https://thediggersplay.com/festivals-schools-and-community-events/)
- [Areas we cover](https://thediggersplay.com/areas-we-cover/)
- [Blog](https://thediggersplay.com/blog/): pricing, party ideas, indoor set-ups, corporate ideas
- [About](https://thediggersplay.com/about/)
